entries.title: The Bow Bells
entries.desc: Bright orange 1860 pub right on Bow Road, said by locals to be haunted.

entries.title: The Peacock
entries.desc: 1881 backstreet pub off Stepney Green, well away from the main roads.

entries.title: The Devereux
entries.desc: Built in 1677 as the Grecian Coffee House and once frequented by Isaac Newton, a couple of minutes from Temple station.

entries.title: The Fenchurch
entries.desc: Former Lloyds Bank branch converted into a pub with a six-figure fit-out, a short walk from Tower Hill.

entries.title: The Bricklayers Arms
entries.desc: Putney's oldest surviving pub, built in 1826, tucked just off the river.

entries.title: The Garden Shed
entries.desc: Wimbledon's oldest pub (1838), plant-themed inside and out.
